app.name: Workbench
computer.overlay: Workbench is controlling this window for “{thread}”. Press {hotkey} to stop.
nav.label: Main navigation
folder.delete_body: Its threads move to the Inbox. No thread is deleted.
folder.deleted: Folder deleted. Its threads are in the Inbox.
settings.privacy.telemetry_body: See exactly what Workbench records about your use and sends to your organization.
telemetry.load_failed: The telemetry records could not be loaded:
telemetry.level.title: Telemetry level
telemetry.level.discarded: Discarded because the buffer was full
telemetry.level.content_active: Content telemetry is active: the text of your prompts, the answers and tool arguments are recorded for your organization.
telemetry.levels_help.metadata: Only metadata is recorded, such as which tools ran, how long they took and which errors occurred. Never your text or file contents.
telemetry.levels_help.content: Metadata, plus the text of prompts, model answers and tool arguments.
telemetry.crashes.title: Crash reports
telemetry.crashes.empty: No crash reports in the last 30 days.
telemetry.crashes.intro: Each report stays here for an hour before it is sent, so you can delete it first. Reports contain thread stacks and the list of loaded modules, without file paths.
telemetry.records.title: Records of the last 30 days
telemetry.records.intro: Newest first. Each record shows exactly the fields that were sent or are waiting to be sent.
telemetry.records.empty: No records in the last 30 days.
status_bar.label: Application status
status_bar.available_title: Colleagues see you as available. Click to show them you are busy.
status_bar.busy_title: Colleagues see you as busy. Messages still arrive. Click to show you as available.
status_bar.content_telemetry_title: Your organization records prompts, answers and tool arguments from this account for as long as its policy says so. Open the Telemetry viewer to see what is sent.
status_bar.context_title: {pct} of the model's context window is used by this thread.
status_bar.context_warn: This thread is close to the model limit. Compact it to continue smoothly.
status_bar.mock_title: Mock host: fake data, no real Workbench process
banner.host_unreachable.title: Workbench cannot reach its background process
banner.host_unreachable.body: {detail} Close this window and open it again from the tray icon.
banner.sign_in_required.title: Sign in to continue
banner.sign_in_required.body: Your session has ended, so Workbench is disconnected. Your local threads stay readable.
banner.signing_in.title: Waiting for sign-in
banner.signing_in.body: Finish signing in in your web browser. This page updates by itself.
banner.locked.title: Access to Workbench was revoked for this installation
banner.locked.body: An administrator has revoked this installation. Active work was stopped. Contact IT support if you think this is a mistake.
banner.version_blocked.title: Update required
banner.version_blocked.body: This version of Workbench is older than the minimum supported version ({min}), so new work is disabled. Update Workbench through the organization software portal.
banner.version_blocked.body_none: This version of Workbench is older than the minimum supported version, so new work is disabled. Update Workbench through the organization software portal.
banner.storage_read_only.title: Local storage is read-only
banner.storage_read_only.body: Workbench cannot save changes on this computer, so new work is disabled. {detail}
banner.storage_read_only.body_none: Workbench cannot save changes on this computer, so new work is disabled.
banner.storage_degraded.title: Local storage is in recovery mode
banner.storage_degraded.body: Workbench could not upgrade its local data and restored a backup. Your data can be read but not changed. {detail}
banner.storage_degraded.body_none: Workbench could not upgrade its local data and restored a backup. Your data can be read but not changed.
banner.not_configured.title: Workbench is not configured
banner.not_configured.body: {detail} Workbench gets its settings from the organization software distribution. Contact IT support if this persists.
banner.not_configured.body_none: Workbench gets its settings from the organization software distribution. Contact IT support if this persists.
list.label: Threads in {view}
list.empty.inbox: No threads here. Start a new thread to give the agent some work.
list.empty.chats: No Chats yet. Find a colleague to start one.
thread.select: Select a thread to read it.
thread.select_hint: Use the arrow keys to move through the list and Enter to open a thread.
thread.load_failed: This thread could not be loaded.
thread.delete_body: The thread, its attachments and its search entries are removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
thread.forked: A new thread was forked from this message.
feed.label: Conversation
feed.show_details_name: Show the reasoning and tool calls of this run
feed.hide_details_name: Hide the reasoning and tool calls of this run
feed.run_usage: Tokens used: {prompt} prompt, {completion} completion, in {calls} model calls.
feed.run_usage_reasoning: Of the completion tokens, {reasoning} were reasoning.
feed.image.label: Generated image, {width} × {height} pixels
feed.image.failed: The image could not be loaded.
feed.image.save_failed: The image could not be saved.
feed.tool.label: Tool call {tool}
approval.title: Approval required
approval.rationale: Why the agent wants to do this
approval.no_provenance: No untrusted content was read before this request.
approval.respond_label: Your answer to the agent, used instead of the tool result
approval.invalid_json: The arguments must be a JSON object.
approval.resolved.approve_edited: You approved this call with edited arguments.
approval.resolved.respond_instead: You answered instead of running the tool.
question.title: Question
question.copy_failed: The text could not be copied.
errors.auth_expired.title: Your sign-in has expired
errors.auth_expired.body: Sign in again, then retry the request.
errors.rate_limit.title: The model is busy
errors.rate_limit.body: Too many requests right now. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.rate_limit.body_none: Too many requests right now. Try again shortly.
errors.model_unavailable.title: The model is unavailable
errors.model_unavailable.body: The model service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.context_length.title: This thread is too long for the model
errors.context_length.body: Fork the thread from a recent message, or compact it, and then continue.
errors.timeout.title: The model took too long
errors.timeout.body: Try again, or split the request into smaller steps.
errors.quota_exceeded.title: Your model quota is used up
errors.quota_exceeded.body_none: Your quota resets at the start of the next period.
errors.other.title: The run failed
composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Write a message. Type / at the start for skills.
composer.new_placeholder: Describe the work for the agent. Type / at the start for skills.
composer.dictation_started: Recording. Speak now, then choose Stop.
composer.dictation_off.models_missing: Dictate: speech recognition is not installed on this computer.
composer.dictation_off.meeting: Dictate: not available while a meeting is being recorded.
composer.too_large: {name} is larger than 25 MB and was not attached.
composer.too_many: At most 10 files can be attached to one message.
composer.hint_idle: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.
composer.hint_running: Enter queues the message for the next turn. Ctrl+Enter steers the running turn.
composer.disconnected: Workbench is disconnected, so new runs are unavailable.
composer.queued: Message queued for the next turn.
composer.queued_offline: Your request waits for the connection.
composer.offline: You're offline. Your request will start when Workbench is connected again.
composer.steered: Steering message sent to the running turn.
composer.new_hint: Closing this window never stops background work.
search.label: Search threads
rail.title: Activity
rail.empty: No delegated work in this thread yet.
folders.delete_body: Its threads move to the Inbox. No thread is deleted.
folders.deleted: Folder deleted. Its threads are in the Inbox.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.commands.toggle_rail: Show or hide the activity rail
status.connection.title: Connection
status.connection.state_help.connected: Connected to the Workbench control plane.
status.connection.state_help.disconnecte: Local features work. Features that need the control plane, including new work, are unavailable.
status.connection.state_help.not_configu: The control plane address is missing or invalid.
status.connection.state_help.update_requ: New work is disabled until Workbench is updated.
status.identity.title: Identity
status.background.title: Background work
status.background.intro: Indexing, transcription, mail and calendar sync and scheduled triggers.
status.background.deferred.storage_index: Indexing paused: storage is nearly full
status.storage.title: Local storage
status.storage.nearly_full: Storage is nearly full. Workbench clears caches and pauses new indexing until space is freed.
status.storage.empty: No local data is stored yet.
status.storage.load_failed: Storage usage could not be read.
settings.later: The settings of this section arrive with a later release of Workbench.
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.language_hint: The window switches to the new language at once.
settings.general.show_work_details_hint: Show the reasoning and every tool call in the thread, for all runs.
settings.general.dictation_language_hint: Automatic detects the language of each dictation. Choose a language if detection gets it wrong on short dictations.
settings.notifications.title: Notifications
settings.notifications.body: Windows notifications for threads you are not looking at. Stopping a run yourself never shows one.
settings.notifications.action: When the agent needs your approval or answer
settings.files.title: Files
settings.mail.title: Mail and calendar
settings.mail.body: Connect your mailbox so the agent can search and read your mail and calendar, draft replies and book meetings. It never sends mail without your approval.
settings.mail.not_configured: Your organisation has not configured mail and calendar access yet.
settings.mail.policy_error: Mail and calendar are turned off because of a policy problem: {reason}
settings.mail.interaction_required: Microsoft asks you to sign in again before Workbench can use your mailbox.
settings.mail.mock: Development build: connected to the Graph mock, not to Microsoft.
settings.mail.connecting: Finish signing in in your browser.
settings.mail.disconnected: Mailbox disconnected. Its local copy was removed.
settings.mail.sync_error: The last sync did not finish: {reason}
settings.mail.exclusions_body: Excluded folders and categories are not synced, searched or shown to the agent.
settings.mail.private_hidden: Private calendar items show only as busy time.
settings.mail.private_shown: Private calendar items are shown like other items.
settings.skills.title: Skills
settings.skills.body: Skills are reusable ways of doing a task. Type / in the composer to use one; the agent also uses one when your request matches its description.
skill_editor.title: Skill editor
skill_editor.delete_body: The Skill and its files are removed from this computer. Versions you published stay in the registry.
skill_editor.drafting: Drafting a Skill from the thread…
skill_editor.drafted: Review the draft before you save it.
skill_editor.draft_failed: The draft could not be made.
skill_editor.test_placeholder: What the Skill gets as input
skill_editor.replaced_body: The draft uses parameters instead of these values. Keep a value only if the Skill really needs it.
skill_editor.org_hint: An organization Skill is reviewed before anyone else gets it.
skill_editor.withdraw_body: The version is no longer distributed to the people it was published to. You cannot publish it again under the same version.
settings.skills.pinned: Pinned by you: updates are offered, not installed.
settings.automations.title: Automations
settings.automations.body: Automations start the agent on a schedule, when files arrive in a folder, or when you sign in. Their Runs are unattended: policy still decides every tool call.
automation.not_found: This automation could not be loaded.
automation_editor.name: Name
automation_editor.cron_hint: minute hour day month weekday, for example 0 8 * * 1-5 for 8:00 on workdays. Or leave it empty and give an interval.
automation_editor.delete_body: The automation and its history are deleted. Threads it created stay.
settings.knowledge.title: Knowledge sources
settings.knowledge.body: Workbench indexes your Threads, folders, mail, calendar and meetings on this computer so the agent can find what you know and cite where it came from. The index stays encrypted on this device.
settings.knowledge.deferred: Indexing is paused while background work is deferred, for example on battery saver.
apps.body: Small web applications the agent built for you. They run on this computer, only you can open them, and they cannot reach the network.
apps.empty: No apps yet. Ask the agent to build one, for example a presentation or a view of your data.
apps.delete_body: {name} is stopped and its folder with all its files and data is deleted.
apps.confirm_body: {name} wants to read data through these MCP tools of yours: {tools}. It can only read, and only while you use it.
knowledge.body: Your knowledge: documents and folders you import, your notes, Threads, mail, calendar and meetings. Everything is private unless you share it.
knowledge.imported: Documents imported. They are indexed in the background.
knowledge.folder_added: Folder added. Its files are indexed in the background.
knowledge.sharing_off: Sharing is not enabled by policy. Your knowledge stays on this computer.
knowledge.team_not_searched: Team knowledge was not searched: Workbench is not connected to your organisation.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.no_facts: No facts were taken from this item.
knowledge.private: Private: only you can find this item.
knowledge.share_unsharing: Being unshared. This finishes when Workbench is connected to your organisation.
knowledge.not_shareable: Only documents, folders and notes can be shared.
knowledge.share_body: Share “{title}” ({size})? Its text is sent to team knowledge, and members of the Groups you select can find it. You can stop sharing at any time.
knowledge.share_none: No Group is available to share with right now.
knowledge.forget_body: Forget “{name}”? Everything derived from it is deleted, and it is not indexed again.
knowledge.exclude_body: Exclude “{name}” from your knowledge? It is removed and not indexed again.
knowledge.draft_hint: Review the note; nothing is stored until you save it.
knowledge.share_copied_mail: This note contains copied mail content.
knowledge.share_copied_chat: This note contains copied Chat messages.
knowledge.delete_note_body: Delete the note “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
knowledge.caption: Documents, notes, Threads, mail, calendar and meetings. Everything stays private unless you share it.
knowledge.reader_empty: Select an item to read it.
knowledge.no_entities: No entities were found in this item.
knowledge.imports_empty: Nothing imported yet. Use Add to import documents or a folder.
knowledge.remove_folder_body: Remove “{name}” from your knowledge? Its files are no longer indexed. The files themselves stay where they are.
settings.knowledge.policy_off: Your organisation has turned this Source off.
settings.knowledge.forget_body: Workbench deletes everything it derived from {name}: passages, embeddings, entities and relations. This cannot be undone.
settings.knowledge.no_folders: No folders yet. Add a folder to index its documents.
settings.knowledge.exclusions_body: Excluded paths and file types are not indexed, and what was indexed from them is deleted.
settings.knowledge.budget_value: {tokens} of {token_limit} embedding tokens, {calls} of {call_limit} extraction calls
settings.knowledge.budget_reached: The daily budget is used up. Indexing continues tomorrow; search still works.
settings.knowledge.extraction_off: Your organisation has turned entity extraction off; nothing is sent to the model for it.
settings.knowledge.reembedding: The embedding model changed; passages are embedded again in the background.
settings.knowledge.entities_body: Merge two entries that are the same person or thing, split off an alias that belongs to someone else, or forget an entity. Forgetting keeps the source items.
settings.knowledge.merging: Choose the entry to merge {name} into.
settings.knowledge.split_done: Split off as a separate entity.
settings.meetings.title: Meetings
settings.meetings.body: Workbench can capture the audio of your meetings with your consent, transcribe it on this computer and write a summary with decisions and follow-ups. Audio never leaves this computer.
settings.meetings.off: Meeting capture is turned off by your organisation.
settings.meetings.available: When a call starts in a meeting app, Workbench asks before it records anything.
settings.meetings.notice_required: When a call starts in a meeting app, Workbench asks before it records anything. Your organisation requires you to tell the participants first; Workbench gives you a notice to post.
settings.meetings.manual_body: Starting a capture yourself counts as your consent. The recording indicator and the participant notice apply as for meetings.
settings.meetings.no_series: No series. Choose Always capture this series when Workbench asks.
settings.about_section.title: About
settings.account.title: Account
settings.account.body: Signing out revokes your session, stops active work and disconnects Workbench. Local data stays on this computer.
settings.account.confirm_body: Active work will be stopped. You can sign in again at any time.
settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
settings.diagnostics.body: Normal logs never contain message text, file contents or tokens. Verbose diagnostics may include them, so they switch themselves off after the time you choose.
settings.connections.title: Connections
settings.connections.body: Organization systems the agent can use, approved centrally in the MCP catalog. Servers start when the agent first needs them and stop when idle.
settings.connections.empty: No connections are assigned to you.
settings.connections.browser.name: Agent browser (Google Chrome)
settings.connections.browser.detail_idle: Chrome {version} · starts when the agent needs it
settings.connections.browser.blocked: Browser use blocked by Chrome policy {policy}
settings.privacy.title: Privacy and data
settings.privacy.policy_none: No policy has been received yet.
settings.privacy.body: Delete everything removes all threads, indexes, caches, logs and settings that Workbench keeps on this computer. Workbench then restarts as if freshly installed. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacy.confirm_body: All local Workbench data will be permanently deleted and Workbench will restart. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacy.done: All Workbench data was deleted. Workbench is restarting.

settings.files.body: Folders you allow the agent to use, within the bounds your organization sets. You can revoke a folder at any time.
settings.files.pick: Choose a folder for the agent
settings.files.none_grantable: Your organization does not allow granting folders (policy.filesystem.grantable is empty).
settings.policy.title: Policy
settings.policy.body: What your organization allows Workbench to do for you, and where each setting comes from. Only an administrator can change it.
settings.policy.ask_admin: Something you need is off? Ask your Workbench administrator to enable it for your Group.
chats.body: Messages with colleagues. They go through your organization's Workbench control plane and are kept there for a limited time.
chats.off: Messaging is turned off by your organisation's policy.
chats.offline: Not connected. You can read your Chats; what you write is sent when Workbench is connected again.
chats.busy_on: Colleagues see you as busy. Messages still arrive.
chats.directory_placeholder: Find a colleague by name or user ID
chats.select_named: Add {name} to a new team Chat
chats.new_name_hint: Needed when you add two or more people
chats.team_incomplete: Enter a name and pick at least one colleague.
chats.save_note_body: Which messages go into the note? You can review and edit it before it is saved.
chats.empty: No Chats yet. Find a colleague to start one.
chats.select: Choose a Chat in the list, or find a colleague to start one.
chats.gone: This Chat is no longer available.
chats.queued: Message queued. It is sent when Workbench is connected again.
chats.leave_body: You no longer get messages from {name}, and it leaves your list.
chats.picker_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
